real_task.defect: reference lifecycle operations collide when independent source owners use the same locator
real_task.public_goal: preserve independent source-owned reference lifecycles across add, remove, replay, supersede response, and concept-retire migration without reducing existing compatibility

agents.private_context: public source only plus the condition-specific contract

functional_boundary.authority_enforcement: deterministic broker accepts actions by runner-bound role id, not text self-identification
functional_boundary.known_limitation: the root research coordinator can read both synthetic dossiers; this is model-context separation, not OS-level or sovereign organizational isolation

conditions.description: one builder sees public code, public symptom, and a static capability card; no owner query
a central builder receives answers from both owners to the same fixed narrow query set, but not raw dossiers
owners choose questions, refusals, disclosures, counterconditions, and a signed joint contract; a separate builder implements only that contract
represented by static condition; removes adaptive questions and joint contract

fixed_central_queries: Which fields identify the local owner and locator?
What exact effect must a local removal have and must not have?
What backward-compatibility behavior is mandatory for source-less historical events?
Which downstream folds or auxiliary events must preserve the same identity?

goal_value_dimensions: concept-retire migration cannot borrow another owner's removal
historical source-less events remain explicitly compatible
existing relevant tests do not regress
acceptance.target_domain_adoption: candidate patch applies cleanly to an isolated HEAD snapshot and passes the experiment-owned hidden evaluator
acceptance.subject_acceptance: both source owners sign the exact lifecycle contract; B may veto the patch rationale
acceptance.final_acceptance: target adoption plus subject acceptance; either alone is insufficient

causal_pressure.primary: paired same-task static, central, and direct-A2A runs
causal_pressure.independent_oracle: compare behavior and missing surfaces with preexisting unmerged commit only after outputs freeze

stopping_rules: all three conditions have frozen outputs and deterministic adoption results
at least one independent review or oracle comparison is complete
or a real model/auth/runtime blocker prevents calls after one bounded diagnostic
